_purpose: Template for Discovery Change Packets. Copy this file, fill in fields, save as change_packets/DCP-NNN_TITLE.json. Part of Hs Change Control v1.0 (INV-063 STAGED).
title: Human-readable title (one line)
trigger: What caused this change packet to exist. Single paragraph.
change_summary: One paragraph summary of the intended change.
not_in_scope: Things explicitly not changed by this packet.

files_to_update.reason: Why this file is touched by this packet
files_to_update.verification: What check confirms the patch is correct

success_criteria: Specific testable statements that, taken together, prove the packet is done.
risk_if_not_done: What goes wrong if this packet is abandoned or delayed.
verification_evidence: Notes added during verified phase: consistency-checker output, test results, manual review records.
release_notes: Notes added during released phase: commit SHA, CI run number, observed CI duration.

lifecycle_statuses.proposed: Packet drafted; impact map not yet executed.
lifecycle_statuses.in_progress: Files are being updated in the working repo.
lifecycle_statuses.implemented: All listed file changes are made.
lifecycle_statuses.verified: Required static checks pass and packet evidence is recorded.
lifecycle_statuses.released: Peter has authorized, committed, pushed, and verified green CI on origin/main.
lifecycle_statuses.superseded: Packet replaced by a later packet.
lifecycle_statuses.abandoned: Packet intentionally not implemented; rationale recorded.
